target.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp AS time, JSONExtractString(Body, 'type') AS type, JSONExtractString(Body, 'project') AS project, JSONExtractString(Body, 'deploy_id') AS deploy_id FROM otel.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['service.namespace'] = 'pop' AND Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime AND match(JSONExtractString(Body, 'type'), 'deploy\..*|alias\.updated') ORDER BY time LIMIT 100

description: pop platform overview (plan 05 T4): requests/404 per project, latency, RGW/function/schedule/form/webhook/browser panels; deploy and alias events as Loki annotations from the structured OTLP log records (spec §Observability). Metric names are the Prometheus translations of crates/pop-sender/src/otel.rs; deploy_id and alias names are never labels.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, concat(project) AS series, value AS value FROM (
  SELECT time, project, sum(d) / greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS value FROM (
    SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['project'] AS project, d
    FROM (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(Value < lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w, Value, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w)) AS d
FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum
WHERE MetricName = 'pop.http.requests' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(Attributes['project'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project))
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    )
  ) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, project
) ORDER BY time, series

panels.description: Request latency quantiles from the pop.http.duration histogram.

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
SELECT *, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(0), BucketCounts), if(Count < lagInFrame(Count, 1, Count) OVER w, arrayMap(x -> toFloat64(x), BucketCounts), arrayMap((c, p) -> if(c >= p, toFloat64(c) - toFloat64(p), toFloat64(c)), BucketCounts, lagInFrame(BucketCounts, 1, BucketCounts) OVER w))) AS deltas
FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram
WHERE MetricName = 'pop.http.duration' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND ($__conditionalAll(Attributes['project'] IN (${project:singlequote}), $project))
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT time, 'p50' AS series, value FROM (
  SELECT time, quantilePrometheusHistogram(0.5)(bound, cum) AS value FROM (
    SELECT time, idx, if(idx <= length(anyb), anyb[idx], inf) AS bound,
           toFloat64(sum(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY time ORDER BY idx ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) AS cum
    FROM (
      SELECT time, bounds AS anyb, idx, sum(deltas[idx]) AS delta FROM (
        SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, ExplicitBounds AS bounds,
               deltas, arrayJoin(range(1, length(deltas) + 1)) AS idx FROM samples WHERE TimeUnix >= $__fromTime
      ) GROUP BY time, anyb, idx
    )
  ) GROUP BY time
) WHERE isFinite(value) ORDER BY time, series
